subject: Using Pygments for Rcpp in Rnw

messages.author: 5f8b51633aa2f2a1
messages.subject: Using Pygments for Rcpp in Rnw
parts:
Hi, 

I see that render_jekyll() has support for pygments, but I'm struggling to find examples of using pygments when targeting LaTeX. 

Is it possible to use pygments instead of highlight for LaTeX documents? I've looked for a hook to replace hi_andre() in knitr:::hilight_source() but my attempts feel rather hackish at this point. 

If it matters, my primary use case is Rcpp chunks. 

Thanks, 
Michael

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: Using Pygments for Rcpp in Rnw
parts:
You can use pygments using the minted package for LaTeX 

https://code.google.com/p/minted/

You will have to tweak how your run LaTeX since minted requires you to enable some command line parameters. 

Hope this helps.

Best,
Ramnath

I'll be happy to accept a pull request if someone wants to contribute
a render_minted() function besides render_latex(), render_sweave() and
render_listings():
https://github.com/yihui/knitr/blob/master/R/hooks-latex.R#L231

To Michael: render_jekyll() does not make use of pygments directly --
Jekyll uses it.
